subject: Budget & unit economics — AdeptApps renewal and new route
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@adeptapps.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Budget & unit economics — AdeptApps renewal and new route

Hi Ellen — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks as we build the renewal/expansion proposal.

Recap of what you shared:
- Current baseline usage: ~25M tokens/month (generation).
- Expected Q3 step-up to ~75M tokens/month as new feature rolls out.
- Embeddings (search/recall) expected to add ~15M tokens/month, initially as a pilot.
- Timeline: procurement review in June; contract target effective date ~1 July 2027.

Immediate asks: could you confirm two pieces so we can lock pricing guidance?
1) A target budget range you have in mind for committed pricing once you add the new route(s) — i.e., target $ per 1M tokens for committed usage.
2) Any constraints on blended pricing across routes (e.g., you need generation and embeddings at a single blended $/1M, or separate line items).

For context, we’ll prepare two options for you: a committed-tier offer with step-up bands, and a blended multi-route offer that smooths pricing across generation + embeddings. Attaching a quick estimate workbook I’ll populate after you confirm the budget range.

Attachments: redwood-q3-estimate.xlsx (estimate stub)

Next steps: if you can share a short budget range and procurement contact by EOD Monday, we’ll aim to send a formal offer and draft SOW for legal review by June 7.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwood.inference | (650) 555-0123

From: Ellen Park <ellen@adeptapps.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@adeptapps.com
Date: 2027-05-30T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget & unit economics — AdeptApps renewal and new route

Hi Marcus — thanks for the summary and for the workbook. Quick answers:

- Budget range: we’re targeting roughly $800–$1,000 per 1M tokens for committed generation traffic once we sign an expansion (this is what leadership expects to see to keep unit economics stable). Today our effective blended is closer to $1,200/1M, so there’s some room if we can get predictable step-ups.
- Embeddings: we treat embeddings separately internally; if embeddings are priced materially higher, we’d prefer to see a blended option that keeps our overall effective $/1M within the band above. For the pilot, plan on ~15M/mo but only a 3-month initial commit for that route.

Procurement (procurement@adeptapps.com) is on cc — they’ll review any contract language/legal.

Let me know if you want a quick 15-min sync with procurement next week.

— Ellen
VP Product, AdeptApps
ellen@adeptapps.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-05-30T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Budget guidance from AdeptApps — proposed pricing options

Neha / Dylan — forwarding Ellen’s reply and my read. She confirmed a target $800–$1,000/1M effective band and wants embeddings pilot (15M/mo, 3-month initial commit). Procurement is on cc.

Draft approach (two options to present):

Option A — Committed step-up (clean, predictable):
- Commit: 60M tokens/month @ $900 per 1M tokens (12-month term)
- Step-up discount: incremental volume up to +90M tokens/month priced at $750 per 1M above the initial commit
- Embeddings: charged as separate line item at $1,200 per 1M for pilot (3 months); convert to blended at review

Option B — Blended multi-route (one effective rate):
- Commit: 75M tokens/month (generation + embeddings) with blended effective rate of $950 per 1M (embeddings included)
- Flex: 3-month embeddings pilot with automatic reblend after pilot period

Notes/considerations:
- Margin: Option A preserves better unit margin on generation but may push embeddings price high; Option B meets customer ask to keep effective under $1,000 but reduces gross margin.
- Capacity: Dylan — can we guarantee the latency/region requirements if we add an embeddings route for AdeptApps in their primary region (us-west)? Any expected capacity bottlenecks if committed 75–150M?
- Legal/terms: Neha — do I have authority to offer the blended $950 flat under standard AE discount caps, or do we need manager approval?

Attachments: route-sample-config.json (sample routing config to show how we would split traffic).

Goal: pick one option to present to Ellen + procurement in a short proposal doc. I’d like Neha’s sign-off today if possible so we can hit their June 7 target for SOW circulation.

Thanks —
Marcus

Proposed (clean offer for approval):
- Committed Tier: 60M tokens/month for 12 months at $900 per 1M tokens (effective monthly invoice).
- Step-up Band: additional volume up to +90M tokens/month priced at $750 per 1M on incremental usage once the commit is exceeded.
- Embeddings Pilot: 15M tokens/month for three months at $950 per 1M (pilot price — convertible to blended rate at pilot end).

Combined example (month when full commit + embeddings active):
- 60M generation @ $900 = effective generation cost
- +15M embeddings @ $950 = embeddings cost
- Overall blended effective rate in this scenario ≈ $915 per 1M tokens (illustrative).

Timing & next steps:
1) Confirm you’re comfortable with the proposed numbers and pilot structure (reply to this thread).
